_note: Every reader-visible string. crates/core/src/page.rs lists the keys the game reads (REQUIRED); GLOSSARY.md and TONE.md govern the words.
title: Chumontillado
no_webgl: This browser cannot draw the game: it needs WebGL 2.
tagline: A shooter in the cellars. Four players, one life a round. For now, the practice room: learn to move and to shoot.
menu_text: The practice room has a slope, two surf ramps, a shaft to climb, straw targets and a bot that hops round the floor. In a duel, the bot shoots back.
control_move: Move, and steer in the air. Faster than a run, W alone turns you toward your view; A or D with the mouse turning the same way adds speed.
control_jump: Jump. Hold it to hop again on every landing.
control_crouch: Crouch. At a run, a slide; jump out of it for more speed. In the air, a slam.
control_wall: A wall jump. The count left shows on screen and fills again on the ground.
hint_play: Esc pauses and lists the controls. 1 to 5 take a gun.
control_fire: Fire. The Pincel charges while held and fires when let go.
control_guns: Take a gun; Q takes the last one again.
